evidence.observation: TestCoder.test_copy_context_respects_auto_copy_context_config - new focused test for the --copy-paste config behavior. Setup: GitTemporaryDirectory + InputOutput(yes=True) and Coder.create(self.GPT35, 'diff', io=io) both without and with auto_copy_context=True, with coder.commands replaced by a MagicMock. Action: coder.copy_context(). Assertions: assertFalse(coder.auto_copy_context) plus coder.commands.cmd_copy_context.assert_not_called() for the default config, and assertTrue(coder.auto_copy_context) plus coder.commands.cmd_copy_context.assert_called_once_with() when the config is enabled.

TestCoder.test_cmd_copy_context_copies_chat_files_and_instructions - new focused test for the /copy-context command output. Setup: a temp file example.py containing 'print('copy context marker')' is added to the chat with Coder.create(self.GPT35, 'diff', io=io, fnames=[fname]) and pyperclip.copy is patched. Action: coder.commands.cmd_copy_context('extra instructions'). Assertions: mock_copy.assert_called_once(); the copied markdown contains the in-chat file content, the 'Just tell me how to edit the files' instruction footer, and the passed 'extra instructions' argument.

The setup/action/assertion discipline the new tests follow: each test inherits a per-test Model('gpt-3.5-turbo') and a patched aider.io.webbrowser.open, then builds the object under test explicitly (Coder.create(...)) and asserts on observable mock calls/data, exactly as the sibling config tests test_no_suggest_shell_commands and test_detect_urls_disabled do.

Coder.copy_context - the config gate under test: copy_context() calls self.commands.cmd_copy_context() only when self.auto_copy_context is truthy, so the default (False, Coder.__init__ keyword at line 339, assigned at line 353) makes it a no-op. Coder.run() calls copy_context() before reading user input (line 883), which is why the flag is user-visible via --copy-paste.

Commands.cmd_copy_context - the command behavior under test: builds markdown from chunks.repo, chunks.readonly_files and chunks.chat_files keeping only user-role messages (assistant messages are skipped), appends the 'Just tell me how to edit the files...' instruction block plus any command args, then calls pyperclip.copy(markdown) and reports 'Copied code context to clipboard.' via io.tool_output. This is why patching pyperclip.copy lets the new test assert the exact clipboard payload.

The --copy-paste CLI flag defined inside get_parser(): BooleanOptionalAction flag with default=False ('Enable automatic copy/paste of chat between aider and web UI'), i.e. the CLI configuration that main.py forwards to Coder.create(..., auto_copy_context=args.copy_paste) and that the new config-gate test exercises at the coder level.

claims.claim: tests/basic/test_coder.py now contains a focused test, TestCoder.test_copy_context_respects_auto_copy_context_config (lines 1037-1057), which follows the file's setup/action/assertion discipline to cover a distinct config behavior: it sets up diff coders via Coder.create with and without auto_copy_context=True, calls coder.copy_context(), and asserts that the /copy-context command is a no-op by default and invoked exactly once when the --copy-paste config is enabled.

tests/basic/test_coder.py also contains TestCoder.test_cmd_copy_context_copies_chat_files_and_instructions (lines 1059-1077), which sets up a coder with an in-chat file, performs coder.commands.cmd_copy_context('extra instructions') with pyperclip.copy patched, and asserts the copied markdown contains the chat-file content, the 'Just tell me how to edit the files' instruction footer, and the passed argument - i.e. the same command the config gate triggers.

Both added tests reuse the existing TestCoder discipline (per-test Model and patched webbrowser in setUp at lines 20-23, explicit construction through Coder.create, assertions on recorded mock calls and payload content) rather than introducing new fixtures or dependencies, so they are drop-in additions to the file's regression suite.

The behavior is grounded in production code: auto_copy_context defaults to False in Coder.__init__ (line 339/353) and Coder.copy_context (lines 894-896) only calls Commands.cmd_copy_context when it is true, while the --copy-paste flag (aider/args.py lines 663-668, default False) exposes that configuration to users.

conclusion: The contract request is satisfied by a test-only change to tests/basic/test_coder.py: two focused unit tests covering a previously untested command/config behavior (--copy-paste / auto_copy_context gating of Commands.cmd_copy_context), written in the same setup/action/assertion style as the surrounding tests and using only existing imports/helpers. No production code, task metadata, lockfiles or git configuration were modified. Static validation (py_compile, ruff check, ruff format --diff, AST check of the new symbols and assertions) passes, and a fallback harness that executes the real upstream method bodies for Coder.copy_context and Commands.cmd_copy_context against stubs passes. The repository's own pytest run for the new tests could not be executed in this sandbox because required dependencies (GitPython, oslex, json5, pyperclip) are absent and must not be installed; that limitation is recorded in validation.notes and in .prale-eval/contract-deliverable.md.
